# Linh V Nguyen — AI & Data Science Writer
# https://nvlinhvn.github.io/

## About

Linh V Nguyen is an independent writer and AI/data science practitioner. Articles cover machine learning, genetic algorithms, genetic programming, optimization, causal inference, data visualization, and economics. Published in Towards AI, Data Driven Investor, and AI Advances on Medium.

## Contact

- LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/linh-v-989a47a1/
- GitHub: https://github.com/nvlinhvn

## Topics Covered

- Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning
- Genetic Algorithms and Evolutionary Computation
- Genetic Programming and Symbolic Regression
- Optimization (gradient descent, local minima, metaheuristics)
- Causal Inference and Natural Experiments
- Data Science and Data Visualization
- Financial Machine Learning and Stock Prediction
- Economic Policy Analysis
